headline: South Africa Plans 5.2 GW of New Nuclear Capacity Using SMRs
summary: South Africa is moving forward with plans to add 5.2 gigawatts of nuclear capacity through small modular reactors (SMRs), supplementing its existing Koeberg nuclear power plant.
why: South Africa relies heavily on aging coal-fired power stations and is seeking alternative energy sources to secure its long-term power grid reliability.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Large-scale national energy infrastructure investments impact the broader domestic economy.
